TX.quote: The amount is equal to 1 ½ times the value of the vehicle.
TX.note: Value comes from the Standard Presumptive Value first, then a NADA guide, then a dealer or insurance adjuster appraisal. You have one year from the notice to buy the bond. No bonded title on a vehicle with a lien under 10 years old without a release.
TX.value_basis: Standard Presumptive Value, then NADA guide, then appraisal

CA.quote: the bond must be for an amount equal to the market value of the vehicle/vessel
CA.note: Needed when regular proof of ownership is missing and the vehicle is worth $5,000 or more. Market value is the midpoint of a valuation guide or a licensed dealer's written appraisal. Bond on DMV form REG 5057, surety signature notarized; a cash deposit can replace it.
CA.value_basis: market value from a valuation guide or dealer appraisal

VT.quote: The value of the bond must be one and one-half times the J. D. Power average trade-in value.
VT.note: The bonded title becomes a regular title after three years.
VT.value_basis: J. D. Power average trade-in value
